* A character who has been made 'forfeit = 0' can still be forfeited, and therefore, can still be revived.
* The revived character is a 'fresh copy' unaffected by any previously applied status effects such as 'forfeit = 0' or 'game text canceled for remainder of turn'.
* The revived character could even battle again this turn (e.g. by moving to another site with [[Nabrun Leids]] and battling there).
* Can only revive the exact card that was forfeited, not another copy of that card or persona.

A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-oldben-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Old Ben (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again (350 × 490 pixels), with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
